title: Window survey tally sheet
subject: Geography
unit: Summer 1: The UK, its capitals and London (Bright Lights, Big City)
source: Seeded from geography/y1 lesson 7 (Window survey tally sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 7: My area and central London. To understand how my home area is similar to and different from central London

questions.q: Is a river human or physical?
questions.model: Did people make the river? No, it is part of nature. So it is physical.

questions.q: Is a bus stop human or physical?
Do a window survey. Tally houses, trees, roads, cars and shops, then circle the biggest number.
questions.a: A tally chart from the pupil's own window with totals
questions.model: Teacher shows the tally from the class photo first.

questions.q: Write one way your area is like London and one way it is different.
questions.a: For example: both have roads; London has much taller buildings

questions.q: Is your area a city, a town or a village? Why?
questions.a: Answer with a reason about size and number of buildings

questions.q: Big question: is your area a city, a town or a village?
questions.a: Any answer with a reason, compared with London
